descriptionChirho: The cardinal numeral four, used independently or in construct to count people, objects, directions, measurements, and time periods, including all prepositional and pronominal-suffix inflections.
The numeral four as the units component of the compound number fourteen (with עָשָׂר/עֶשְׂרֵה 'ten'), used for dates, counts, and measurements, including all prepositional inflections.
